Title: General availability: MATCH clause for Query

Body.Content:
The MATCH clause is a query offering that allows you to specify which pattern should be followed while traversing relationships in the Azure Digital Twins graph. The MATCH clause allows you to run variable hop and/or bi-directional queries in your solution. 

Learn more.
